subject: RE: Encord - data management solution
text:
Hi Andrew,
Thank you for the follow-up, and for sharing the overview.
 
To be transparent about where we stand: our team is currently building our own data platform in-house, so any external solution would need a strong, well-documented case before we bring more colleagues into the discussion. The current deck is a helpful introduction, but it doesn’t yet give us enough technical detail to make a meeting productive. I’d therefore like to suggest we postpone until we can review more concrete material.
In particular, it would help us greatly if you could share details on:

	Support for autonomous-driving sensor data (multi-camera video, LiDAR point clouds), with a focus on AI-native features beyond annotation and how they differentiate Encord from open-source tools like CVAT.
	The model evaluation workflows referenced in the Woven by Toyota case study.
	Your commercial model, including licensing and pricing.

Once we’ve had a chance to review this information, I’ll identify the right teammates to join the discussion and get back to you with some proposed meeting times.
Apologies for the change of plans, and thank you for your understanding.
 
Best regards,
